careers.title: B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
careers.overview: Core engineering discipline covering software engineering, algorithms, database systems, networking, and computing theory.
careers.eligibility: 12th Pass with Physics, Chemistry, Maths (Min 60%) + JEE / Entrance score
careers.future_scope: Continuous high global demand across tech giants, startups, and enterprises.

careers.title: MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery)
careers.overview: Primary professional undergraduate medical degree for aspiring doctors, training in clinical diagnosis, surgery, and pharmacology.
careers.eligibility: 12th Pass with Physics, Chemistry & Biology (Min 50%) + NEET UG score
careers.future_scope: High demand globally with opportunities for MD/MS specialization.

careers.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML)
careers.overview: Specialization in building autonomous systems, neural networks, computer vision, and large language models (LLMs).
careers.future_scope: Top priority field globally powering the AI revolution.

careers.title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.overview: Premier accounting qualification managing financial auditing, taxation, corporate finance, and governance.
careers.future_scope: Indispensable in corporate compliance and financial management.

careers.title: UI/UX Designer & Product Designer
careers.overview: Focuses on user research, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and designing digital product interfaces.
careers.eligibility: 12th Pass + Portfolio / NID or UCEED Entrance
careers.future_scope: Critical role for every software product, app, and web startup.

careers.title: Civil Services Officer (IAS / IPS / IFS)
careers.overview: Prestigious administrative and policing leadership roles serving the nation through public policy execution.
careers.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline + Age 21 to 32 years
entrance_exams: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, Interview)
careers.future_scope: Highest social impact and administrative governance roles in India.
